use_case_requirements: Workload: low-latency chat for live support + embeddings for search. Target: p95 <= 500ms for chat messages during business hours (US-PST). Throughput: ~10 req/s sustained during peak, bursts to 40 req/s for support spikes. Cost: high sensitivity — want to avoid oversized models. Model preference: small/medium open models or Redwood-curated low-latency variants. Fallback: prefer automatic model fallback to slightly cheaper variant with graceful degradation; need simple routing by region.
latency_metrics: Observed: p50 ~220ms, p90 ~540ms, p95 ~1100ms (sample window 2026-03-01 08:00-16:00 PST). Errors: no increased 5xx; mostly higher tail latencies and occasional 2s+ spikes.
suggested_perf_tuning_notes: Recommended: 1) Region choice: run tests in us-west-2 for west coast latency; use closest region to user base. 2) SDK timeouts: set connect timeout 500ms, request timeout 1500ms for chat; implement client-side deadline slightly under app timeout. 3) Prompt guidance: trim system + user context, push long docs to embeddings + retrieval, limit max_tokens for predictable tail. 4) Use streaming responses to start sending tokens earlier for perceived latency. 5) Enable prefix caching for repeated system messages. 6) Consider a lower-latency model family for interactive traffic (swap for embedding/rerank jobs). 7) Monitor tokenization cost and provide token budgets per route.
